meta.title: A pricing stage without trade products is refused
gaps: cannot explicitly set rfx_mode in add_rfq_round; assuming default rfq

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer adds a pricing (RFQ) round to the event with no data.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event still has no round (nothing was added).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Product not found”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event still has no round (nothing was added).

plan.title: A pricing stage without trade products is refused

assert.say: the event still has no round (nothing was added)
